risk_notes.pooled_MR: Paper-style independent-weight reconstruction reuses outcome estimates; compare the fixed single-IV sensitivity.
risk_notes.single_IV: One strongest exposure instrument selected before outcome matching; no fallback for missing instruments; not the recovered author analysis.
risk_notes.CI: MVP outcome SE inferred from reported CI is not generally equivalent to the source P value.
risk_notes.TGFBI: External nominal association has the opposite direction.
